items.subEn: Confirm it falls between 16°40' and 30° Pisces, the final mansion of the wheel

items.subEn: Look for themes of communication, guidance, and bridging rather than heavy finality
items.subZh: 关注沟通、引导与连接的主题，而非沉重的终结感

items.subEn: Frame the placement around safe passage and nourishing protection of others in transition
items.subZh: 将此位置理解为安全过渡与滋养性保护，关注引导他人穿越转变

items.subEn: Let compassion and intuition color the Mercurial clarity rather than compete with it
items.subZh: 让慈悲与直觉为水星的清晰着色，而非与之对立

items.subEn: Treat the placement as a symbol of crossing into what comes next, not a literal forecast of events
items.subZh: 将此位置视为跨越门槛、迈向下一阶段的象征，而非字面上的命运预言
